description: Local learning dashboard for SLA Report Generator Prometheus metrics. Counters show activity over the selected time range, gauges show current values, and histogram panels calculate averages or percentiles from bucket, count, and sum series. A blank panel can mean that operation has not happened yet.

panels.description: How to interpret this learning dashboard.

options.content: Use the customer and user-group filters to focus the report metrics. Counters are converted into activity during the selected time range. Gauges show current values. Histogram charts are calculated from their `_bucket`, `_count`, and `_sum` series. Blank charts are expected until the related operation has happened at least once. Plugin timings include successful stages only; queue depth means started but unfinished tasks; worker memory is shared process memory, not memory owned by one customer.
